name: Oath of Vengeance
desc: Oath of Vengeance: a paladin subclass. Hand-written summary, not the book text.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
features.desc: Frighten one creature (save ends). A frightened creature's speed is 0.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
features.desc: Gain advantage on attack rolls against one creature for 1 minute.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.desc: After an opportunity attack hits, you can move half your speed toward the target.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.desc: When your Vow of Enmity target attacks, you can attack it as a reaction.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.desc: Become winged and frightening for 1 hour.
